nodes.name: Fetch Script Titles
nodes.notes: Chapter titles for the impact cards come from the script's [CHAPTER n: title] markers. Missing script degrades to the narration-excerpt fallback.

parameters.query:
select id, "createdTime", fields from hov.at_script
where id = $hov${{ (($('Fetch Project Info').first().json.fields || {}).scripts || [])[0] || 'missing' }}$hov$

nodes.name: Find Music Folder
nodes.notes: Background music lives in the user's Drive folder named 'Muzica'. Missing folder = video without music, never an error.

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files?pageSize=200&fields=files(id,name,mimeType)&q=' + encodeURIComponent("'" + ((($json.files || [])[0] || {}).id || 'missing') + "' in parents and trashed = false") }}
